1. **msbuild/Xamarin.Shared/Xamarin.Shared.props** — The precedence/fallback logic doesn't match the PR description. `MonoMacResourcePrefix`/`XamMacResourcePrefix`/`IPhoneResourcePrefix` are defaulted to `"Resources"` in this same block *before* `AppBundleResourcePrefix` is computed, so by the time the `AppBundleResourcePrefix` fallback conditions run, those legacy properties are never empty — the "inherit from legacy property" path effectively only ever yields `"Resources"` unless the user explicitly set the legacy property themselves. Worse, the stated goal #3 ("legacy properties default to the new property if not explicitly set") is never implemented: setting only `AppBundleResourcePrefix` does not flow back into `IPhoneResourcePrefix`/`MonoMacResourcePrefix`/`XamMacResourcePrefix`, so any other code elsewhere in the build that reads those legacy property names directly (not via `_ResourcePrefix`) will not see the user's unified value. Fix: capture whether each legacy property was empty *before* applying its own "Resources" default, use that to drive `AppBundleResourcePrefix`, and then propagate `AppBundleResourcePrefix` back down into any still-unset legacy properties so all consumers agree.

2. **tests/dotnet/UnitTests/ResourcePrefixTest.cs, `GetTestProjectContent`** — `<Message Text=""$({GetProperty})"" .../>` is a C# interpolated string referencing the undefined identifier `GetProperty`; this will not compile (CS0103). It should emit literal MSBuild text like `$($(GetProperty))` (the standard "evaluate the property named by the command-line property" idiom), not a C# interpolation hole. This breaks the build entirely and must be fixed before merge.

3. **tests/dotnet/UnitTests/ResourcePrefixTest.cs, `GetResourcePrefix`/`ExecuteGetPropertyCommand`** — Each test case shells out to a full `dotnet build` and parses raw stdout (`stdout.Trim()`) to extract the property value; this is slow (16+ full builds across the 4 tests/platforms) and fragile, since any additional build output (SDK banners, warnings, restore messages) would break the trim-based parsing even with `-v:minimal`. Prefer reusing whatever existing MSBuild-property-evaluation helper this test project already has (or the SDK's native `-getProperty:` evaluate mode, which avoids a full build) instead of hand-rolling a custom target + stdout scrape.

4. **Scope gap** — The PR only updates `_ResourcePrefix` derivation in `Xamarin.Shared.props`. There's no evidence the rest of the codebase was checked for other direct consumers of `IPhoneResourcePrefix`/`MonoMacResourcePrefix`/`XamMacResourcePrefix` (e.g. in resource-rule/signing-related targets). If any exist, they won't pick up a user-set `AppBundleResourcePrefix`, undermining the "unify" claim in the PR title. Should grep the repo for other usages of these three properties and update them (or confirm none exist) before merging.

5. **docs/building-apps/build-properties.md** — The new `AppBundleResourcePrefix` section claims it "will inherit its value from the platform-specific resource prefix properties," implying two-way compatibility, but per finding #1 that inheritance is effectively one-directional/broken. Doc should not be merged describing behavior the implementation doesn't deliver.

6. **tests/dotnet/UnitTests/ResourcePrefixTest.cs** — missing trailing newline at EOF; should match repo file-formatting conventions enforced elsewhere in the test suite.
